svg.title: One word, three readings; one count, one reading
svg.desc: Three identical dials sit in a row on a bridge, each turned by its own spindle. In front, a toothed rack marked 38 meshes with every spindle's gear and has turned each by the same number of teeth: the three needles agree, lit teal. Behind, a smooth bar marked READY only presses smooth rollers, which slip; dashed magenta needles show the three different readings it left.
